# [Implementation] - The IMPLEMENT → QUALITY_GATE → REVIEW boundary contract (issue #327)

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #327 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Every block runs from the worktree root. The sandboxes are under the tool's own
recognised isolation root (`$HOME/.cache/agyloop/…`), are destroyed at the end
of their block, and no block mutates the repository checkpoint.
`codeloop` is invoked through this worktree's `bin/codeloop.js`, so the built
`dist/` under test is the worktree's, not an installed copy.

#### Check 1 — the build and the new domain exports exist

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
npm run build
node -e "const d = require('./dist/domain'); const need = ['ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS', 'formatImplementAdvanceCommand', 'formatPlanReapprovalRecovery', 'formatGateEvidenceRequiredMessage', 'formatTransitionRecoveryCommands']; const missing = need.filter((key) => !(key in d)); if (missing.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL missing domain exports: ' + missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('domain exports present:', need.join(', '));"
```

#### Check 2 — Defect 1: fixture-seed accepted, genuine JSON comparison rejected

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
node <<'JS'
const { SmokeProtocol } = require('./dist/domain');
const heading = '### Manual Smoke Test Protocol';
const open = ['# Plan', '', heading, '', '```bash'];
const close = ['```', ''];
const plainComparison = '[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"' + ' = "$BEFORE" ] && echo "PASS unchanged" || echo "FAIL moved"';
const jsonComparison = 'if [ "$(state 283 currentStage)"' + ' = "PLAN" ]; then echo PASS; fi';
const fixtureSeed = [
  ...open,
  'BEFORE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)',
  `node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('x.json', JSON.stringify({ a: 1 }))"`,
  plainComparison,
  ...close
].join('\n');
const genuine = [
  ...open,
  'state() {',
  "  node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(process.argv[1]))' \"$1\"",
  '}',
  jsonComparison,
  ...close
].join('\n');
const quoted = (plan) => SmokeProtocol.fromPlan(plan).findings.filter((f) => f.rule === 'quoted-json-comparison');
const fixtureFindings = quoted(fixtureSeed);
const genuineFindings = quoted(genuine);
if (fixtureFindings.length !== 0) {
  console.error('FAIL the fixture-seed block was flagged: ' + JSON.stringify(fixtureFindings));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (genuineFindings.length !== 1) {
  console.error('FAIL the genuine JSON comparison was not flagged exactly once: ' + JSON.stringify(genuineFindings));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!SmokeProtocol.fromPlan(fixtureSeed).executable) {
  console.error('FAIL the accepted block is still not executable');
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('quoted-json-comparison: fixture accepted, genuine rejected');
JS
```

#### Check 3 — Defect 2: `QUALITY_GATE` recovery is legal and named

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-327-replan"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/artifacts/plans/327-task" "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks"
git -C "$SBX" init -q -b main
git -C "$SBX" config user.email smoke@test
git -C "$SBX" config user.name smoke
printf 'base\n' > "$SBX/README.md"
git -C "$SBX" add README.md
git -C "$SBX" commit -qm 'chore: base'
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const fence = '`'.repeat(3);
const plan = [
  '# Plan', '',
  '## 3. Implementation Steps', '',
  '- [ ] Step 1: repair the smoke protocol', '',
  '### Quality Gate Targets', '',
  fence + 'bash', 'npm test', fence, '',
  '### Manual Smoke Test Protocol', '',
  'Run the smoke test by hand and report the result.', ''
].join('\n');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join('artifacts', 'plans', '327-task', 'implementation_plan.md'), plan);
const now = new Date().toISOString();
const root = process.cwd();
const snapshot = {
  version: '1.0.0',
  currentStage: 'QUALITY_GATE',
  mode: 'standard',
  issue: 327,
  baseBranch: 'main',
  planDir: path.join(root, 'artifacts', 'plans', '327-task'),
  worktree: null,
  createdAt: now,
  updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'QUALITY_GATE', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null,
  pausedAtTimestamp: null,
  totalHumanWaitMs: 0
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join('.agyloop', 'tasks', '327.json'), JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2));
JS
)
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 327 --json > blocker.json
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('blocker.json', 'utf8'));
if (payload.actionType !== 'human_gate') { console.error('FAIL expected a human gate, got ' + payload.actionType); process.exit(1); }
if (payload.title !== 'Manual Smoke Test Protocol Not Executable') { console.error('FAIL title: ' + payload.title); process.exit(1); }
if (payload.nextStage !== 'PLAN') { console.error('FAIL nextStage must name the recovery (PLAN), got ' + payload.nextStage); process.exit(1); }
const text = payload.description + '\n' + payload.humanSummary;
const required = [
  'codeloop transition PLAN --issue 327',
  'codeloop transition APPROVAL --issue 327',
  'codeloop transition IMPLEMENT --issue 327',
  're-records the plan digest'
];
const missing = required.filter((token) => !text.includes(token));
if (missing.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL recovery is missing: ' + missing.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('blocker names the legal re-approval sequence and the digest re-record');
JS
  node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition PLAN --issue 327
  node <<'JS'
const state = JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.json', 'utf8'));
if (state.currentStage !== 'PLAN') { console.error('FAIL first hop did not land at PLAN: ' + state.currentStage); process.exit(1); }
console.log('QUALITY_GATE -> PLAN is executable');
JS
)
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

#### Check 4 — Defect 3: no evidence refuses; filed evidence records; late filing names the walk-back

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-327-gate"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/artifacts/plans/327-task" "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks"
git -C "$SBX" init -q -b main
git -C "$SBX" config user.email smoke@test
git -C "$SBX" config user.name smoke
printf 'base\n' > "$SBX/README.md"
git -C "$SBX" add README.md
git -C "$SBX" commit -qm 'chore: base'
printf '# Plan\n\n## 3. Implementation Steps\n\n- [ ] Step 1: repair the gate exit\n' > "$SBX/artifacts/plans/327-task/implementation_plan.md"
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
const root = process.cwd();
const snapshot = {
  version: '1.0.0',
  currentStage: 'QUALITY_GATE',
  mode: 'standard',
  issue: 327,
  baseBranch: 'main',
  planDir: path.join(root, 'artifacts', 'plans', '327-task'),
  worktree: null,
  createdAt: now,
  updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'QUALITY_GATE', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null,
  pausedAtTimestamp: null,
  totalHumanWaitMs: 0
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join('.agyloop', 'tasks', '327.json'), JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2));
JS
)
set +e
( cd "$SBX" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 327 ) > "$SBX/refused.out" 2> "$SBX/refused.err"
REFUSED_CODE=$?
set -e
if [ "$REFUSED_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL transition REVIEW succeeded without gate evidence"
  exit 1
fi
grep -q "Gate evidence refused" "$SBX/refused.err"
grep -q "codeloop gate-report --issue 327" "$SBX/refused.err"
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.json', 'utf8'));
if (state.currentStage !== 'QUALITY_GATE') { console.error('FAIL stage moved to ' + state.currentStage); process.exit(1); }
if (state.history.some((entry) => entry.stage === 'REVIEW')) { console.error('FAIL a REVIEW entry was written'); process.exit(1); }
if (fs.existsSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.gate.json')) { console.error('FAIL an evidence file was created by a refusal'); process.exit(1); }
console.log('no evidence: refused, nothing written, no REVIEW entry');
JS
)
cat > "$SBX/gate.json" <<'JSON'
GATE_REPORT_JSON:
{ "verdict": "PASSED", "buildSystem": "node", "buildStatus": "PASSED",
  "testsStatus": "PASSED (3 passed)", "testsPassed": 3, "testsFailed": 0,
  "durationMs": 1000, "executedCommands": ["npm test"],
  "smokeProtocol": "NOT_DECLARED", "notRun": [] }
JSON
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 327 --report-file gate.json
  node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 327
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.json', 'utf8'));
const last = state.history[state.history.length - 1];
if (state.currentStage !== 'REVIEW') { console.error('FAIL stage ' + state.currentStage); process.exit(1); }
if (last.metadata.gateVerdict !== 'PASSED') { console.error('FAIL recorded verdict ' + last.metadata.gateVerdict); process.exit(1); }
if (fs.existsSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.gate.json')) { console.error('FAIL evidence was not consumed'); process.exit(1); }
console.log('filed evidence: transition REVIEW recorded PASSED and consumed the file');
JS
)
set +e
( cd "$SBX" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 327 --report-file gate.json ) > "$SBX/late.out" 2> "$SBX/late.err"
LATE_CODE=$?
set -e
if [ "$LATE_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL filing past QUALITY_GATE succeeded"
  exit 1
fi
grep -q "Gate evidence refused" "$SBX/late.err"
grep -q "transition IMPLEMENT --issue 327" "$SBX/late.err"
grep -q "transition QUALITY_GATE --issue 327" "$SBX/late.err"
echo "late filing refused and named the legal walk-back"
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

#### Check 5 — Defect 4: clean vs implemented worktree at `IMPLEMENT`

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-327-implement"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX"
git -C "$SBX" init -q -b main
git -C "$SBX" config user.email smoke@test
git -C "$SBX" config user.name smoke
printf 'base\n' > "$SBX/README.md"
git -C "$SBX" add README.md
git -C "$SBX" commit -qm 'chore: base'
git -C "$SBX" worktree add -q -b task/327-boundary "$SBX/.worktrees/327" main
mkdir -p "$SBX/artifacts/plans/327-task" "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks"
printf '# Plan\n\n## 3. Implementation Steps\n\n- [ ] Step 1: name the advancing command\n' > "$SBX/artifacts/plans/327-task/implementation_plan.md"
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
const root = process.cwd();
const snapshot = {
  version: '1.0.0',
  currentStage: 'IMPLEMENT',
  mode: 'standard',
  issue: 327,
  baseBranch: 'main',
  planDir: path.join(root, 'artifacts', 'plans', '327-task'),
  worktree: {
    taskId: '327',
    worktreePath: path.join(root, '.worktrees', '327'),
    branch: 'task/327-boundary',
    baseBranch: 'main',
    isIsolated: true
  },
  createdAt: now,
  updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'IMPLEMENT', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null,
  pausedAtTimestamp: null,
  totalHumanWaitMs: 0
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join('.agyloop', 'tasks', '327.json'), JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2));
JS
)
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 327 --json > next-clean.json
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('next-clean.json', 'utf8'));
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.json', 'utf8'));
const text = payload.description + '\n' + payload.humanSummary;
const missing = [];
if (payload.role !== 'implementer') missing.push('role=implementer');
if (!text.includes('codeloop transition QUALITY_GATE --issue 327')) missing.push('advancing command');
if (!text.includes('This stage ends when an implementation diff exists in the task worktree.')) missing.push('completion condition');
if (payload.implementationPresent !== false) missing.push('implementationPresent=false');
if (!text.includes('Implementation not present:')) missing.push('absent wording');
if (state.currentStage !== 'IMPLEMENT') missing.push('next advanced the stage');
if (state.implementationDispatchCount !== 1) missing.push('dispatch count 1 (got ' + state.implementationDispatchCount + ')');
if (missing.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL clean worktree: ' + missing.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('clean worktree: command named, absent reported, dispatch 1, stage unchanged');
JS
)
mkdir -p "$SBX/.worktrees/327/src"
printf 'export const probe = 1;\n' > "$SBX/.worktrees/327/src/probe.ts"
printf 'implemented\n' >> "$SBX/.worktrees/327/README.md"
(
  cd "$SBX"
  node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 327 --json > next-present.json
  node <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('next-present.json', 'utf8'));
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.agyloop/tasks/327.json', 'utf8'));
const text = payload.description + '\n' + payload.humanSummary;
const missing = [];
if (!text.includes('codeloop transition QUALITY_GATE --issue 327')) missing.push('advancing command');
if (!text.includes('This stage ends when an implementation diff exists in the task worktree.')) missing.push('completion condition');
if (payload.implementationPresent !== true) missing.push('implementationPresent=true');
if (!text.includes('Implementation present:')) missing.push('present wording');
if (!text.includes('do not re-dispatch the implementer')) missing.push('do-not-redispatch instruction');
if (state.currentStage !== 'IMPLEMENT') missing.push('next advanced the stage');
if (state.implementationDispatchCount !== 2) missing.push('dispatch count 2 (got ' + state.implementationDispatchCount + ')');
if (missing.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL implemented worktree: ' + missing.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('present worktree: condition flipped, command named, dispatch 2, stage unchanged');
JS
)
rm -rf "$SBX"
```
